tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The successful Bidder shall remit the Contract Management Module (CMM) processing fee at the rate of 0.025% of the contract value, subject to a minimum of Rs.500/- and a maximum of Rs.7500/-, immediately after issuance of the Contract Order, as per the prevailing KPPP/e-Procurement guidelines.

The Bidder shall possess adequate knowledge and experience in providing House Keeping Services and shall have the necessary organizational setup, infrastructure, manpower resources, and capacity to satisfactorily perform the services specified in the tender.

Notwithstanding the above, if it is found that the performance of the Bidder in respect of works or services previously awarded by HESCOM is unsatisfactory or substantially behind schedule, HESCOM reserves the right to disqualify the Bidder and reject the bid at any stage of the tender evaluation process.

If at any stage of the tender process the information furnished by the Bidder is found to be false, incorrect, or misleading, HESCOM reserves the right to disqualify the Bidder, reject the bid, forfeit the Bid Security, and initiate appropriate action including blacklisting of the firm. If such information is found to be false, incorrect, or misleading during the execution of the contract, HESCOM reserves the right to terminate the contract, forfeit the Performance Security, recover any losses incurred, levy liquidated damages as applicable, and initiate appropriate action including blacklisting of the firm.

No claim on account of cost escalation for wages, materials, taxes, statutory contributions, or any other expenditure arising during the contract period shall be entertained by HESCOM. The rates quoted by the successful Bidder shall remain firm and binding throughout the contract period.

The Bidder shall upload all documentary evidence, supporting documents, and credentials pertaining to the qualifying requirements and other tender requirements through electronic mode only within the stipulated time. Failure to upload the required documents within the prescribed time shall render the bid liable for rejection.

The Bidder shall upload all required documents in the respective sections of the KPPP Portal as specified in the tender. Uploading documents in incorrect sections or failure to upload the required documents in the prescribed locations may render the bid liable for rejection.

The Service Charges quoted by the successful Bidder shall remain firm and unchanged throughout the contract period and shall not be subject to any escalation or reduction on account of variation in minimum wages, EPF, ESI, GST, or any other statutory components.

Any benefit, incentive, subsidy, reimbursement, or concession received by the Agency from the Government of India, Government of Karnataka, or under any Scheme or Yojana in respect of EPF, ESI, or other statutory contributions relating to the deployed personnel shall be passed on or adjusted accordingly. All statutory payments shall be claimed on actual basis only and no additional profit or service charge shall be admissible on such statutory components.
All other terms and conditions shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the provisions of the tender documents and subsequent amendments, if any.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall have a minimum experience of one year in providing manpower outsourcing services for House Keeping Services as on the date of tender notification. The Bidder shall have deployed a minimum of 50% of the tendered manpower strength, that is 02 Nos. of House Keeping Staff, to KPTCL, ESCOMs, Government Departments, Semi Government Organizations, or Public Sector Undertakings during any one of the preceding three financial years, namely 2023-24, 2024-25, and 2025-26.The Bidder shall upload documentary evidence in support of the above requirement, including experience and performance certificates issued by a competent authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer, along with copies of the Detailed Work Award (DWA) or Work Order evidencing satisfactory execution of the services. The Bidder shall furnish the Experience Certificate as per Annexure-1 and upload the same.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Bidder shall furnish the Experience Certificate as per Annexure-1 and upload the same.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall upload clear scanned copies of all documents required for Technical Evaluation in support of the qualifying requirements specified in the tender.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Valid EPF Registration certificate shall be uploaded
Others -- Valid ESI Registration certificate shall be uploaded
Others -- Valid GST Registration issued by the respective competent
Others -- Bidder Pan Card shall be uploaded
Others -- Valid Labour License of registration certificate of establishment for Manpower shall be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall provide the full number of House Keeping Staff as specified in the tender. If the Bidder is unable to provide the required manpower at the time of award, the Bidder shall furnish the additional required manpower within 10 days from the date of issue of the Letter of Intent (LOI), failing which the offer shall be liable for rejection. The Bidder shall furnish a self declaration in this regard as per Annexure-2 and upload the same.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self Declaration as per Annexure-2 shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall provide details of any litigation or arbitration arising out of contracts completed or under execution during the last five financial years, namely 2021-22 to 2025-26, with KPTCL or any ESCOM. A history of awards involving litigation against the Bidder or any constituent of a Joint Venture may result in rejection of the bid. The Bidder shall furnish a self declaration in this regard as per Annexure-3 and upload the same.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self Declaration regarding litigation or arbitration as per Annexure-3 shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall not have been blacklisted by any Government Department, KPTCL, ESCOM, Power Utility, Local Body, or any Government Organization. The Bidder shall furnish a self declaration in this regard as per Annexure-4 and upload the same.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self Declaration regarding non blacklisting as per Annexure-4 shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall furnish an undertaking to deploy House Keeping Staff possessing the minimum qualifications prescribed in the tender and to pay wages not less than the minimum wages notified by the competent authority from time to time. The Bidder shall furnish the undertaking as per Annexure-5 and upload the same.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Monthly rate of minimum wages payable to House Keeping Staff as per Annexure-5 shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall not have been declared as a defaulting contractor or subjected to short closure of any contract due to non performance in the execution of works or services awarded by KPTCL, ESCOMs, Government Distribution Utilities, Government Transmission Utilities, Public Sector Undertakings, or any other Government Organization as on the date of bid submission. The Bidder shall furnish a self declaration in this regard as per Annexure-6 and upload the same.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self Declaration regarding non defaulting status and non short closure of contracts as per Annexure-6 shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall engage only Kannadigas for deployment as House Keeping Staff under the contract. The deployed personnel shall be able to read, write, and speak Kannada as per the prevailing Government norms. The Bidder shall furnish a self declaration in this regard as per Annexure-7 and upload the same.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self Declaration regarding engagement of Kannadigas and Kannada language proficiency of the deployed House Keeping Staff as per Annexure-7

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall comply with the Government of Karnataka Reservation Circular dated 20/05/2024 and amendments issued thereto from time to time for availing services through outsourcing agencies. The Bidder shall furnish an undertaking in this regard as per Annexure-10 and upload the same. Any violation of the provisions of the said Circular during the contract period shall render the contract liable for termination.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Undertaking regarding compliance with Government of Karnataka Reservation Circular dated 20/05/2024 as per Annexure-10.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall possess liquid assets consisting of Cash Credit, Term Deposits, or available credit facility in any Nationalized Bank or Scheduled Commercial Bank amounting to not less than 25% of the amount put to tender, that is Rs.0.47 Lakh, as on or after the date of tender notification. The Bidder shall furnish a Credit Facility Certificate issued by a Nationalized Bank or Scheduled Commercial Bank in the format prescribed under Annexure-8. The Credit Facility Certificate shall contain the name of the Firm, Tender Number, and shall be addressed to the Superintending Engineer (Ele), O & M Circle, HESCOM, Chikodi. Conditional Credit Facility Certificates are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Credit Facility Certificate issued by a Nationalized Bank or Scheduled Commercial Bank as per Annexure-8 shall be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Annual Turnover of the Bidder in any one of the three financial years, namely 2022-23, 2023-24, and 2024-25, shall not be less than 100% of the amount put to tender, that is Rs.5.39 Lakhs. The Bidder shall furnish Annual Turnover Certificate, Audited Balance Sheet, Profit and Loss Account duly certified by a Chartered Accountant, and Income Tax Return in support of the above requirement.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover
Others -- Profit and loss account balance sheet shall be uploaded
